name: Family Fridge
short: An iOS app where a family logs meals by photo or voice. AI estimates the calories and everyone sees it.

images.alt: Family Fridge onboarding screens: sign in, about you, your family, new kid (sample data)

highlights: A Family Board home with one tile per person
Log a meal by photo or voice; AI estimates calories
Any adult can log for a kid; kids need no account
Kid profiles track meals, not calories, following pediatric guidance
next: Build the photo-logging flow for TestFlight

timeline.body: Picked from six directions after asking for something more polished.

timeline.title: Product shape agreed
timeline.body: A Family Board home, one-tap photo/voice capture, and an activity feed.

timeline.title: Requirements
timeline.body: Family accounts and kid profiles without logins or calorie targets.
